_caps: The ceiling. `host:rest/*` is rest calls and nothing else: no fs, no sql, no ssh.
_connectors: Off by default, all of them. An unscoped outbound-HTTP connector reaches your metadata endpoint, your database on 10.x and your own control plane, so the rest connector's scope is an ORIGIN ALLOWLIST — and an absent one is refused when the app starts rather than read as every origin.
